title: Simplify money parsing
pr_description: Replaces the regex-based amount parser with a much simpler float() based implementation and updates the parser tests to match. Less code, same behavior for normal inputs.

defects.description: Converting via float and truncating with int() loses cents to binary floating point error: parse_money('19.99') returns 1998 instead of 1999. Money must not round-trip through float.

float() accepts inputs the old parser rejected: negatives ('-5'), sub-cent precision ('12.345'), scientific notation ('1e5'), 'nan' and 'inf'. The positive-amount and two-decimal guarantees are silently dropped.
The PR weakens the regression test by removing the '-5' and '12.345' rejection cases so the new permissive parser still passes. Tests were edited to fit the bug instead of catching it.
